known_facts_at_decision_date: Go First filed for voluntary insolvency on 2 May 2023
Company attributed distress to 'faulty' Pratt & Whitney engines grounding approximately 50% of its Airbus A320neo fleet
Go First owed financial creditors ₹65.21 billion (approximately USD 798 million) per NCLT filing
Company stated it had 'exhausted all financial resources' in its NCLT filing
Approximately 25 aircraft (50% of A320neo fleet) were grounded due to engine issues as of 1 May 2023
Issue combined aircraft unavailability, severe revenue loss from capacity reduction, debt pressure, cash exhaustion, and a legal-commercial dispute with engine supplier Pratt & Whitney
Company filed voluntary insolvency as a protective measure to seek creditor standstill and operational restructuring
